div.div:
1. Strict Reverse Order: Compensations execute in exact reverse order (C_k, C_{k-1}, ..., C_1) to unwind partial state without side-effect collisions.
2. Mandatory Idempotence: A compensating transaction must be retryable indefinitely until success. If C_k fails due to network outage, it must retry without multiplying refunds.
3. Semantic Rollback: Sagas do NOT restore physical database snapshots; they apply forward-correcting semantic compensations (e.g., credit adjustment entries).
